label: lem:continuous_at_interior
title: Continuity at interior points
statement: If $f$ is continuous on $[\min(a,b), \max(a,b)]$ and $x \in (\min(a,b), \max(a,b))$, then $\texttt{ContinuousAt}\; f\; x$. The closed interval is a neighborhood of $x$ by \texttt{Icc\_mem\_nhds}, so continuity on the set implies pointwise continuity.
